candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Ra, kt, and k_rms are length measures (height statistics) so they carry dimension L^1. Skewness (Sk), kurtosis (Ku), effective slope (ES), and porosity (Po) are dimensionless statistical or geometric ratios, so they carry no base dimensions. Therefore the normalized parameter ks/Ra is dimensionless when ks has dimension L, consistent with ks being a length. Assignment is high confidence because these are standard statistical/geometric quantities.

Peak-to-valley height (total vertical distance between highest peak and lowest valley)
Root-mean-square of surface height fluctuations

Kurtosis of the distribution of surface height fluctuations (fourth standardized moment)
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness (rise/run, geometric slope)
Surface porosity (fraction of void area relative to total surface area)
